mentions.name: Fabling.app
mentions.description: This app helps people learn languages (Spanish) by using AI to generate stories pitched slightly beyond the learner's current understanding (i+1 input), mostly using words they know or are learning plus a few new ones. It tracks the learner's vocabulary and how often they look up definitions, and auto-generates a vocab review deck using FSRS/Anki-style spaced repetition.
mentions.problem: The author got tired of trying to learn Spanish with Duolingo and wanted a more efficient, AI-driven learning approach.
mentions.audience: Learners studying languages (Spanish in particular), including the author who was frustrated with Duolingo.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Fabling.app

Got tired of trying to learn Spanish with Duolingo.

This uses the parts of AI that can actually help one learn efficiently, namely:
- generate stories that are slightly beyond your understanding (i+1) - i.e mostly words you know or are learning, and a few new words
- tracks your vocab and how often you lookup définitions
- auto generates a vocab review deck (using fsfr Anki style)
mentions.author: peab
